systematic_findings: Boss Heart Containers are ordinary Obj_Heart_Container pickups (Obj_Item_Base, NoRespawn) placed in the dungeon's own Static map (boss rooms are rooms of the dungeon map, not separate scenes). Each is spawned by its boss room's logic module (AiGroup referencing the HC hash): ActorLogicSimpleActor.Logic_Create is fed by the same 'boss defeated' flag/BoolExp that feeds the boss prefab's Create_WarpPrefab input. Decoded from the .ainb node graphs (AINB v0x408; same layout as TotK). The warp never depends on the HC being picked up.
Only the Deku Tree module uses the HC's Dead output: it sets InsideTheDekuTree_Heart_Container_Obtained, which feeds the HC's own Logic_Delete. No other module consumes an HC's Dead output.

Each boss's after-fight timeline Dm_<Dungeon>_BossOut (Dm_Deku_BossOut, Dm_DodongoCave_BossOut, Dm_InsideJabu_Jabu_BossOut, Dm_ForestTemple_BossOut, Dm_FireTemple_BossOut, Dm_WaterTemple_BossOut, Dm_SpiritTemple_BossOut, Dm_ShadowTemple_BossOut) casts an 'Obj_Heart_Container' with its own event model (Work/Model/Event/Dm_X_BossOut/Dm_X_BossOut_Obj_Heart_Container). Only the timeline's string table was read. The cutscene probably still shows a heart descending whatever the map actor becomes. Whether it binds to the real actor (IsBindNearestActor / EventMemberCreateMethod are in its string table) is unknown.

Dungeon rewards are not given in the boss room. The blue warp's EventRequestActor runs an entry of Dm_SY_BancChange_EscapeDungeon. That entry (or the BootEventName of the area it loads) EventTransitions to the reward cutscene, and the cutscene gives the item with call GetPouchContent:GetPouchContentByActorName {ActorName}. Story progress is done separately, by ChallengeSystemActor.EventExecuteProgressChallengeStep in Dm_SY_BancChange_EscapeDungeon (e.g. Get_StoneOfForest Complete, DoorOfTime_CheckStoneNum). No logic module or flow query checks the stone/medallion in the pouch (searched every flow switch and Logic/*.ainb).

Event/EventFlow/EventFlowFileEntry.Product.110.byml.zs is {'Versions': {flow: '110'}} for 13 flows: Dm_Awake_Fire/Forest/Shadow/Spirit/Water_Get, Dm_DodongoCave_0010, Dm_FinalBattle_BossOut, Dm_Goron_0040, Dm_HrlCastle_0020, Dm_InsideJabu_Jabu_0030, DreamBossStage, MiniGame_HorseRace, Npc_Hylia_Dampe_001. So for those flows the game most likely loads '<flow>.110.bfevfl.zs', not the base file. rando.events.Events.flow() reads the base file. Patch both. (For the 5 medallion flows and Jabu_0030, the base and .110 dumps are identical.)
